name: Neeznáá Dah Yíjihí
description: Neeznáá Dah Yíjihí (Navajo Tens) is a traditional Navajo fishing card game where players compete to capture cards from a central layout by making combinations that sum to 10.

overview.description: Neeznáá Dah Yíjihí (Navajo Tens) is a traditional Navajo fishing card game where players compete to capture cards from a central layout by making combinations that sum to 10.

history.origins: Traditional Navajo card game played among Navajo communities in the USA. The Navajo name is Neeznáá Dah Yíjihí or sometimes Da'aka' (general word for card game). A documented variant uses a double deck with 80 cards and meld-11 Conquian-style play for 2–7 players; fishing-style capture versions summing to ten are also played in Navajo communities.
timeline: 20th century: Traditional Navajo fishing game played in Navajo communities in the USA.
history.cultural: Important part of Navajo gaming culture and recreational traditions.
history.evolution: Variant of fishing games with capture mechanics adapted for Navajo play traditions.

setup.dealing: Four cards dealt to each player, four cards face-up in the center. Remaining cards form the draw pile.

rules.objective: Capture the most cards by making combinations that sum to 10.
rules.gameplay: On your turn, play one card from your hand. Capture cards from the center that combine with your card to make 10 (e.g. play 7, capture 3). Multiple cards can be captured if their sum equals 10. If you cannot capture, add your card to the center. Draw to replenish after each play.
keyRules: If no capture possible, card is added to center layout

tips: Remember which cards are in the center layout for better capturing decisions.
Plan ahead - if you cannot capture, your card stays in the center.
Prioritize capturing multiple cards at once to deny opponents captures.

scoring.description: Players capture cards that sum to 10; the player with the most captured cards wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Navajo fishing game where players capture cards from the tableau that total ten.
